sources.label: Patch of things I daily use.
sources.author: Fakh
patch_list: Clone
Installs the app as a separate app next to the Play Store version, under its own name. Progress is not shared between the two.
Daily bonus
Adds money to your wallet at the start of every day.
Disable analytics
Turns off analytics, crash reporting, Play Integrity checks, and device-ID telemetry, and spoofs the Android device ID. Google cloud save still works.
GmsCore support

Makes "Tautkan akun" with Google work by signing in through microG RE (GmsCore) instead of Google Play services, so the warung saved to your Google account comes back. Needs microG RE installed and signed in to a Google account.
Instant ad rewards
Gives the rewards of rewarded ads without watching them and skips the level-up ads.
Legendary fish chance
Makes the legendary fish (Ikan dewa) bite more often than the usual 0.6% of catches.
Sales income multiplier
Makes every sale to a customer pay several times its price.
Themed icon
Adds the themed app icon of Android 13 and later, which follows the wallpaper colors.
Unlimited ad rewards
Lets you use the energy refill and the upgrade discount of rewarded ads as often as you like, instead of once a day and six times per upgrade.
Unlock tester outfit
Unlocks the Kaos & sarung outfit that is a reward for the game's testers.
